itineraries.title: The Classic Fjord Roadtrip
itineraries.description: Experience the absolute best of Fjord Norway, from historic Bergen to the majestic Geirangerfjord.

day_by_day.title: Arrival in Bergen
day_by_day.description: Explore the UNESCO-listed Bryggen wharf and take the Fløibanen funicular for a panoramic view of the city.

day_by_day.title: The Flåm Railway
day_by_day.description: Take the scenic train from Bergen to Myrdal, then down the steep mountain valley to Flåm on the famous Flåmsbana.

day_by_day.title: Nærøyfjord Cruise
day_by_day.description: Take a silent electric ferry cruise through the spectacular Nærøyfjord, then spend the evening in the village of Aurland.

day_by_day.title: Drive the Snow Road
day_by_day.description: Drive the spectacular Aurlandsfjellet National Tourist Route towards the inner Sognefjord, stopping at the Stegastein viewpoint.

day_by_day.title: Sognefjord to Geiranger
day_by_day.description: A full day driving north through glacier country and steep valleys to reach the iconic Geirangerfjord.

day_by_day.title: Geirangerfjord Viewpoints
day_by_day.description: Visit the Flydalsjuvet viewpoint and hike up to Storsæterfossen to walk behind the waterfall.

day_by_day.title: Trollstigen & Departure
day_by_day.description: Drive the famous Trollstigen mountain road (the Troll's Ladder) before heading to Ålesund for your departure flight.

itineraries.title: The Arctic Explorer
itineraries.description: A thrilling adventure above the Arctic Circle, chasing the northern lights, steep peaks, and the northernmost edge of Europe.

day_by_day.title: Welcome to Tromsø
day_by_day.description: Arrive in the 'Paris of the North', visit the Arctic Cathedral, and take the Fjellheisen cable car.

day_by_day.title: Senja Bound
day_by_day.description: Pick up a rental car and drive to the island of Senja. Stop at the Tungeneset viewpoint for sunset.

day_by_day.title: Hiking in Senja
day_by_day.description: Hike the iconic Segla or Hesten trails for dramatic ocean-facing mountain views.

day_by_day.title: Ferry to Lofoten
day_by_day.description: Take the summer ferry from Gryllefjord (Senja) to Andenes, then drive south into the Lofoten Islands.

day_by_day.title: Lofoten Highlights
day_by_day.description: Explore the fishing villages of Henningsvær and Nusfjord. Enjoy a seafood dinner in a traditional rorbu.

day_by_day.title: Reine and Å
day_by_day.description: Drive to the stunning southern tip of Lofoten. Hike Reinebringen if you're up for the steep stairs.

day_by_day.title: Flight to Alta
day_by_day.description: Drive to Leknes or Evenes airport, drop the car, and catch a flight to Alta in Finnmark.

day_by_day.title: Drive to the Edge
day_by_day.description: Rent a car in Alta and drive the barren, beautiful plateau up towards Honningsvåg.

day_by_day.title: The North Cape
day_by_day.description: Visit Nordkapp, the northernmost point of mainland Europe. Stand at the globe monument under the midnight sun (or northern lights).

day_by_day.title: Departure
day_by_day.description: Drive back to Alta or catch a flight from Honningsvåg (HVG) to conclude your Arctic expedition.

itineraries.title: The National Parks Explorer
itineraries.description: A hiker's dream itinerary moving through Norway's highest mountains and most pristine wilderness areas.

day_by_day.title: Lillehammer Culture
day_by_day.description: Arrive in Lillehammer, explore the Maihaugen open-air museum and the 1994 Olympic ski jump arena.

day_by_day.title: Into Rondane
day_by_day.description: Drive north into Rondane National Park. Hike the gentle, moss-covered trails surrounded by 2,000-meter peaks.

day_by_day.title: Scenic Route to Jotunheimen
day_by_day.description: Drive the Valdresflye National Tourist Route into Jotunheimen, 'Home of the Giants'.

day_by_day.title: The Besseggen Ridge
day_by_day.description: Take the ferry across Lake Gjende and hike the famous Besseggen Ridge back to Gjendesheim (challenging but rewarding).

day_by_day.title: Return to Oslo
day_by_day.description: Enjoy a quiet morning by the mountains before driving the scenic Route 51 back down towards Oslo.

itineraries.title: Oslo in One Day
itineraries.description: A fast-paced, curated 24-hour itinerary covering the absolute highlights of Norway's capital city.

day_by_day.title: The Ultimate Oslo Loop
day_by_day.description: Morning: Walk the roof of the Opera House and explore the Munch Museum. Afternoon: Take the ferry to Bygdøy to see the Fram polar ship museum. Evening: Stroll through Vigeland Sculpture Park, followed by dinner at Aker Brygge.

itineraries.title: Trondheim in One Day
itineraries.description: Experience the historic capital of the Vikings, known for its Gothic cathedral and colorful wharves.

day_by_day.title: Viking History & Wharves
day_by_day.description: Morning: Marvel at the Nidaros Cathedral, the northernmost medieval cathedral in the world. Afternoon: Walk across the Old Town Bridge (Gamle Bybro) and photograph the colorful Bakklandet wharves. Evening: Enjoy a Michelin-level dinner in this recognized European capital of gastronomy.

itineraries.title: Preikestolen and Kjerag
itineraries.description: An intense, thrilling 3-day itinerary from Stavanger to conquer Norway's two most famous cliff hikes.

day_by_day.title: Stavanger & Lysefjord Cruise
day_by_day.description: Arrive in Stavanger, explore the charming white wooden houses of Gamle Stavanger, and take a 3-hour fjord cruise into the Lysefjord to see the cliffs from below.

day_by_day.title: Hike to Preikestolen
day_by_day.description: Take the bus from Stavanger and hike to Preikestolen (Pulpit Rock). Stand 604 meters straight above the fjord. Spend the night in the Stavanger area or near Lysebotn.

day_by_day.title: Conquer Kjerag
day_by_day.description: Take the early morning ferry deep into the Lysefjord to Lysebotn. Endure the challenging hike to the Kjeragbolten boulder wedged in the mountain crevasse, then return to Stavanger.
